title: Retired numbers and cities: production too full
notes_for_john: Both fixes are done on DS1 but not released. Production is 457 MB and release.py prepare allows 450 MB. Releases 2026.10.18-1 to -3 were withdrawn. core.person_jersey is 22 MB on production; its jersey-roster rows copy core.roster_stint and a rerun rewrites about 59k rows.

decision.question: How do we make room on production for the jersey data?

options.label: Stop publishing jersey-roster rows; the site reads numbers from core.roster_stint
Trim api.player_index (41 MB) or api.person_admin (27 MB)
